reason: Gray as the carabao's true skin color is sound (swamp buffalo are typically slate-gray; not dirt) and TL/BIS (kulay-abo/abuhon, balat/panit) are OK, but no current core facet teaches animal skin color. Carabao is the Philippine national animal and is kept nationwide (Luzon to Mindanao); the 'because found in every province' reason is incomplete (cultural/agricultural role) but not false. TL/BIS OK. G6-L-4 matches 'carabao' without teaching vertebrate vs invertebrate; G4-L-3/G4-L-4 require habitat diagrams/tables the card does not teach.
